name: Bond coupon drip
oneLiner: an engraved certificate on real paper (guilloche border, rosette medallion with the rate) rises into frame; one by one its perforated coupons tear off, each turns into a real gold coin that arcs onto a growing pile with a green +amount, the running total counts up and the last coin lands with a glint and a ring of light
say: when the speaker explains something that pays out again and again (a bond's coupon, a dividend, an evergreen video, a product that sells while you sleep): cut in on the asset, each coin lands as a period is counted, the total lands on the punchline
